title: Software R&D Engineer (Remote)
description:
WorkNomads is seeking a
Software R&D Engineer
to join our diverse team, working remotely from the EU or from the WorkNomads base in Sofia, Bulgaria.
The R&D Development Engineer is responsible not only for delivering technically sound solutions but also for ensuring that all systems meet high standards of security, reliability, and compliance. This includes designing secure APIs, protecting sensitive data across mobile and backend systems, proactively managing vulnerabilities, and embedding security best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
In this role, the engineer takes technical ownership of the platform and maintains uniformity within the team. Conduct high-quality code reviews, support other engineers, and document key technical decisions to ensure long-term maintainability and shared understanding.
Beyond pure engineering, the candidate should demonstrate strong product and business awareness, translating product goals into scalable and cost-effective technical solutions. They actively balance delivery speed, technical debt, system robustness, and operational cost, discussing trade-offs transparently and aligned with business priorities.
Success in this role requires
exceptional communication skills,
the ability to make informed decisions under uncertainty, and a strong
sense of ownership
. The engineer will collaborate with product, design, and operations teams, challenge assumptions constructively, and support the engineering organization in delivering sustainable value over time.
The tools in your backpack:
3-5 years of experience
Python - Backend services, data processing, async programming, FastAPI, Flask, Django
IOS native app development
RESTful API design and implementation
Microservices architecture
Nginx hand-on experience
Databased and Data layers – PostgreSQL/MySQL/ SQLite
NoSQL databases – MongoDB
Containers and deployment strategies and applications (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines)
Other nice-to-have tools:
AI integration and deployment
Flutter/Dart knowledge
C/C++ experience
MS Azure, Firebase, or any other cloud system
NoSQLdatabases

title: Front Office Host - Hotel & Guest lounge (Onsite)
description:
Job Description
We are seeking a dynamic and service-oriented Front Office Host to support our digitally managed hotel operation. This hybrid role combines guest reception duties with beverage service in our guest lounge and breakfast area, which shares space with the hotel’s restaurant. You will provide warm, personal service, guide guests through the digital check-in process and coordinate with hotel staff and procedures. You’ll also support hotel breakfast and assist in serving drinks and light meals during the day.
This position is ideal for someone with hospitality or F&B experience who thrives in a digital, guest-facing environment and enjoys delivering both operational excellence and heartfelt service.
Dare to have a mission
Front Office & Guest Experience
Greet and assist guests through the digital check-in and check-out process
Ensure guests are accommodated in rooms that reflect their booking details and preferences
Maintain awareness of in-house and arriving guests, including special requests and VIPs

Provide basic concierge-style support and coordinate with the back office for smooth operations
Breakfast & Lounge Service
Set up and monitor the hotel breakfast service (buffet or à la carte as applicable)
Welcome guests for breakfast, assist with any special dietary needs or preferences
Serve drinks and light meals during the day in the lounge or restaurant area
Maintain cleanliness and atmosphere of the lounge area, ensuring a pleasant guest environment
Follow food safety and hygiene standards
The tools in your Backpack
Prior experience in hotel front office, hospitality, or F&B service
Confident with digital tools and PMS platforms (e.g., Cloudbeds, Opera, tablets, POS systems)
Comfortable handling food and beverages
Fluent in English and Bulgarian (other languages are a plus)
Strong communication and multitasking skills
Service-first mindset and a natural host personality
Well-groomed, presentable, and reliable
Able to work flexible shifts, including mornings, weekends, and holidays
